name: 3,4-dihydroxymethcathinone
summary: 3,4-Dihydroxymethcathinone (HHMC), or 3,4-dihydroxy-N-methylcathinone, is a monoamine releasing agent of the amphetamine and cathinone families. It is an active metabolite of methylone (3,4-methylenedioxymethcathinone; MDMC).

pharmacology.text: 3,4-Dihydroxymethcathinone (HHMC), or 3,4-dihydroxy-N-methylcathinone, is a monoamine releasing agent of the amphetamine and cathinone families. It is an active metabolite of methylone (3,4-methylenedioxymethcathinone; MDMC). The drug is a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA), with EC50 values of 110 nM for norepinephrine, 90 nM for dopamine, and 14,100 nM for serotonin in rat brain synaptosomes.
